abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze computed tomography (CT) features of primary non-teratomatous germ cell tumors of the mediastinum and to improve the diagnostic efficacy of CT for such tumor. METHODS: Fifteen patients with primary non-teratomatous germ cell tumors of the mediastinum, proven pathologically, were enrolled. All patients underwent non-enhanced and contrast-enhanced CT examinations. The CT features, including location, size, shape, edge, CT attenuation, involvement of adjacent structure and local or distant metastasis of each lesion were retrospectively analyzed. RESULTS: Each case showed single mass, a total of 15 masses. 11 masses arose within the left anterosuperior mediastinum and 4 masses arose within the right anterosuperior mediastinum. 10 masses appeared lobulated and ill-circumscribed, and 5 masses appeared rounded or oval and well-circumscribed. The maximal diameter of all the masses ranged from 5 cm to 16 cm (mean, 11 cm). 12 masses revealed heterogeneous attenuation on non-enhanced CT images with patchy low-attenuation foci and stippled calcification, and showed moderately heterogeneous enhancement after contrast administration. 3 masses of the patients with seminoma revealed homogeneous attenuation on non-enhanced CT images and showed lightly homogeneous enhancement after contrast administration. Pericardial effusion, pleural effusion and involvement of adjacent vascular structures were observed in 6, 5 and 10 cases, respectively. Pulmonary metastasis were observed in 3 cases. CONCLUSIONS: The characteristic CT findings of primary non-teratomatous germ cell tumors of the mediastinum include bulky, ill-circumscribed, lobulated masses, heterogeneous attenuation with low-attenuation foci and calcification on non-enhanced CT images and heterogeneous enhancement after contrast administration. Seminomas may show homogeneous attenuation and homogeneous enhancement after contrast administration. The tumor is apt to involve pericardium, pleura and adjacent vascular structure and develop distant metastasis. Primary non-teratomatous germ cell tumors should be considered when anterosuperior mediastinal masses are detected with these findings, especially in young males.
abstract_ja:
目的:原発性非奇形腫性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のCT所見を解析し、この腫瘍に対するCTの診断能を向上させること。
方法:病理学的に確認された原発性非奇形腫性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の患者15例を対象とした。全例で単純CTおよび造影CTを施行した。部位、大きさ、形状、辺縁、CT値、隣接構造への浸潤、各病変の局所および遠隔転移について、後方視的に解析した。
結果:各症例は単発の腫瘤で、計15個の腫瘤であった。11個は左前上縦隔、4個は右前上縦隔に発生した。10個の腫瘤は分葉状で境界不明瞭であり、5個は円形または楕円形で境界明瞭であった。全腫瘤の最大径は5cmから16cm(平均11cm)であった。12個の腫瘤は単純CTで不均一な濃度を示し、淡い低濃度域と点状石灰化を伴い、造影後は中等度に不均一に増強された。セミノーマの患者の3個の腫瘤は、単純CTで均一な濃度を示し、造影後は軽度に均一に増強された。心膜液貯留、胸水、隣接血管構造への浸潤はそれぞれ6例、5例、10例で認められた。肺転移は3例で認められた。
結論:原発性非奇形腫性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の特徴的なCT所見は、巨大で境界不明瞭な分葉状腫瘤、単純CTで低濃度域と石灰化を伴う不均一な濃度、造影後の不均一な増強である。セミノーマは均一な濃度と造影後の均一な増強を示すことがある。この腫瘍は心膜、胸膜、隣接血管構造に浸潤しやすく、遠隔転移を生じやすい。前上縦隔に腫瘤が検出され、これらの所見を伴う場合、特に若年男性では原発性非奇形腫性胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきである。
